main_text.head: SECT. II.
main_text.p: Dividuntur ut apud Hebraeos, in Gutturales, Linguales, Palatinos, Dentales & Labiales, & eædem sunt apud utrosque. Quiescentes apud Syros sunt tres tantùm, [illegible, ~5 letters] non quiescit, ideo nec mappic unquam habet.

page.notes: The first line begins mid-paragraph, so the paragraph is marked as continuing from the previous page. The symbol after "vocali" is an unidentified printed sign, marked [?]. The last word is cut off at the bottom of this part and stays incomplete.
